# =============================================================================
# tessera-term: esctest cases that FAIL on main today  (issue #15, wave 5; spec-researcher output)
# crates/tessera-term/tests/fixtures/esctest_pending.txt
#
# Companion to esctest_spec.txt, same layout and provenance (see its header), ids N_*. These are the full
# bytes/expectations behind the `#>` lines there that name #93 and #94. tests/esctest.rs (pending_cases_still_fail)
# parses this file and requires every N_* case to FAIL, whole and byte by byte: the fix PRs for #93-#96 lift the
# matching N_* blocks from it into esctest_spec.txt (renamed E_*), where they must pass, and delete them here.
# Today only #93 and #94 have blocks here; #95 and #96 have `#>` lines in esctest_spec.txt only. On main 17c5cf3 all 7
# fail (probe through spec::check_case, whole and byte by byte). The 8th researcher row, N_DECRC_reset, passes since
# #80 merged (PR #98) and is the live case E_DECRC_saveRestoreCursor_reset in esctest_spec.txt.
#   N_HPR_* / N_VPR_*  -> #93 (CSI Pn a / CSI Pn e not handled)
#   N_SCORC_basic      -> #94 (CSI s / CSI u not handled)
# =============================================================================
